summary: DockerImages 88e329f on phase/023-P2: new backup-server package internal/freshness reads every folder under the remote at startup, hourly and after each upload's prune (one listing per folder, only each stream's newest declaring metadata file read, cached), keeps last values on failure, and serves per-stream last-backup/valid-until plus last-refresh-success and start-time gauges via client_golang on a separate :8081 GET /metrics listener. gofmt/vet clean, go test -race ./... green on Go 1.26 and 1.24; done-record appended and P3/P5 updated with the port and series names (AnsibleSpecs 210c0d8).
